code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    rm, cm = (r0 + r1) // 2, (c0 + c1) // 2
    markers = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0, 5)]
    for r, c, color in markers:
        top = r < r0
        left = c < c0
        for rr in range(r0 + 1, r1):
            for cc in range(c0 + 1, c1):
                cell_top = rr <= rm
                cell_left = cc <= cm
                if (cell_top == top and cell_left == left) or (cell_top != top and cell_left != left):
                    out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
'''
